atomic_claims.control: Suppress only that exact diagnostic for the exact sealed grant after all other generic checks run.

atomic_claims.claim: A release advance can strand an otherwise valid completion.
atomic_claims.control: Permit one CAS-pinned H only while the exact unexpired CLAIMED lease remains valid.

atomic_claims.claim: Completion is not crash-safe at two ordering cuts.
atomic_claims.control: Reconcile PREPARED+CLAIMED and terminal receipt state before ordinary active-claim rejection.

atomic_claims.claim: Git configuration can redirect or weaken authenticated transport.
atomic_claims.control: Isolate global/system config, reject case-folded includes and local rewrite/helper overrides, and preserve TLS verification.

adverse_findings: A broad base/path exception would weaken every durable receipt.
A dynamically accepted descendant H would expand continuation authority.
An includeIf chain can load http.sslVerify=false while a literal origin string still appears correct.
A stale intent without exact terminal evidence must remain fail closed.
acceptance_conditions: H is pinned once under O_EXCL while the exact claim is CLAIMED and unexpired.
Every later check requires that exact H and transitions ACTIVE to CONSUMING to CONSUMED.
Generic and nonsealed receipts retain all ordinary checks.
dissent: The continuation is intentionally unavailable after the original claim or its bounded continuation expires.
